Consumers check ``contract_version`` before taking traffic instead of

post.description:
Search memories for a specific user.

This endpoint uses the class-based SearchHandler for better code organization.

Add memories for a specific user.

This endpoint uses the class-based AddHandler for better code organization.

Return what the reader would extract from the messages, without writing.

Mirrors the cloud ``extract/memory`` contract: facts/preferences only, no
graph or vector-store writes, no scheduler task.

Create a new memory cube for a user.

Memory cubes are containers that store different types of memories (textual, activation, parametric).
Each cube can be owned by a user and shared with other users.

**Note on cube_id vs mem_cube_id:**
These terms are used interchangeably throughout the API:
- `cube_id` is the canonical identifier for a cube
- `mem_cube_id` appears in many legacy endpoints and means the same thing
- When using other endpoints (search, add, chat), you can reference this cube using either term

**Semantic Clarification:**
- **Single mem_cube_id** (deprecated): Used in older endpoints to identify a single cube.
  New code should use `readable_cube_ids` / `writable_cube_ids` lists instead.
- **readable_cube_ids**: List of cube IDs the user can read from (used in search/chat)
- **writable_cube_ids**: List of cube IDs the user can write to (used in add/chat)
Return the prompt saved for ``mem_cube_id``, or the built-in default.

Persist the full extraction prompt for one project.

The prompt must keep the ``${conversation}`` placeholder.

post.description:
Register an existing memory cube with the MOS system.

This method loads and registers a memory cube from a file path or creates a new one
if the path doesn't exist. The cube becomes available for memory operations.

**Note on cube_id vs mem_cube_id:**
These terms are used interchangeably throughout the API. The registered cube can then
be referenced by its cube_id/mem_cube_id in other endpoints.

**Current Status:**
This endpoint validates the registration request. Full registration functionality
requires architectural integration with MOSCore, which will be completed in a future update.

async_mode.description: Whether to add memory in async mode. Use 'async' to enqueue background add (non-blocking), or 'sync' to add memories in the current call. Default: 'async'.

mode.description: (Internal) Add mode used only when async_mode='sync'. If set to 'fast', the handler will use a fast add pipeline. Ignored when async_mode='async'.

custom_tags_match.title: Custom Tags Match

custom_extract_prompt.title: Custom Extract Prompt
custom_extract_prompt.description: Per-request extraction guidance keyed by stage: detail_factual, preference, skill, profile, event, tool_memory, image, document. The text only decides what to extract or ignore; the output structure stays the default. 'document' falls back to 'detail_factual'. Each value is at most 4000 characters.

messages.description: List of messages to store. Also supports pure input items when there is no dialog.

include_memory_view.description: Cloud-compatible recall whitelist. When provided it takes precedence over the legacy `include_preference` / `include_skill_memory` / `search_tool_memory` switches.

knowledgebase_ids.description: Knowledge bases to recall alongside user memory. Accepted for contract compatibility; KB recall is disabled while `KB_RECALL_ENABLED=false`.

time_aware.title: Time Aware
time_aware.description: Read the time wording in `query` (e.g. 上周, 去年3月, 以前, last 7 days) and answer for that moment: a window selects which version of a changeable fact (or which event) was valid then, past wording attaches `history_versions`, and a query without time wording returns only what is currently valid. Falls back to the unrestricted result when nothing matches. Omit to follow the server default (`SEARCH_TIME_AWARE`, off).

include_history.title: Include History
include_history.description: Attach `metadata.history_versions` (earlier versions of the memory, newest first) to each hit that has any. Does not change which memories are returned.

readable_cube_ids.title: Readable Cube Ids
readable_cube_ids.description: List of cube IDs that are readable for this request. Required for algorithm-facing API; optional for developer-facing API.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session ID used as a soft signal to prioritize more relevant memories. Only used for weighting, not as a hard filter.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of textual memories to retrieve (top-K). Default: 9, max: 25 (aligned with the cloud recall cap).

relativity.title: Relativity
relativity.description: Relevance threshold for recalled memories. Only memories with metadata.relativity >= relativity will be returned. Use 0 to disable threshold filtering. Default: 0.45.

dedup.title: Dedup
dedup.description: Optional dedup option for textual memories. Use 'no' for no dedup, 'sim' for similarity dedup, 'mmr' for MMR-based dedup. If None, default exact-text dedup is applied.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Optional post-retrieval sort key. Leave unset to keep the retrieval (relativity) order. `chat_time` sorts by the event time carried over from the input messages.

sort_order.title: Sort Order
sort_order.description: Sort direction used when `sort_by` is set. Default: 'desc'.

rerank.title: Rerank
rerank.description: Whether to apply the textual memory reranker during search. Set false to return retrieval-order candidates before post-search dedup/formatting.

pref_top_k.title: Pref Top K
pref_top_k.description: Number of preference memories to retrieve (top-K). Default: 6.

include_preference.title: Include Preference
include_preference.description: Whether to retrieve preference memories along with general memories. If enabled, the system will automatically recall user preferences relevant to the query. Default: True.

dream_mem_top_k.title: Dream Mem Top K
dream_mem_top_k.description: Number of cross-case synthesis memories (daily digest + derived insights) to append as extra slots. They are returned in a separate `dream_mem` bucket and never compete with `text_mem`. Default: 1.

include_dream_memory.title: Include Dream Memory
include_dream_memory.description: Whether to append cross-case synthesis memories along with general memories. If enabled, the system will additionally recall daily digests and derived insights relevant to the query. Default: False (opt-in).

search_tool_memory.title: Search Tool Memory
search_tool_memory.description: Whether to retrieve tool memories along with general memories. If enabled, the system will automatically recall tool memories relevant to the query. Default: True.

tool_mem_top_k.title: Tool Mem Top K
tool_mem_top_k.description: Number of tool memories to retrieve (top-K). Default: 6.

include_skill_memory.title: Include Skill Memory
include_skill_memory.description: Whether to retrieve skill memories along with general memories. If enabled, the system will automatically recall skill memories relevant to the query. Default: True.

skill_mem_top_k.title: Skill Mem Top K
skill_mem_top_k.description: Number of skill memories to retrieve (top-K). Default: 3.

context_format.title: Context Format
context_format.description: How hits read in the search context: 'memory' (default) returns the extracted memory text; 'sources' returns the original messages each conversation hit was extracted from (the extracted text moves to metadata.extracted_memory); 'mixed' (alias 'heuristic_routing') picks one of the two per query. Any other value is passed through to an installed search.context.render plugin, and rejected with 422 when none is installed.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Optional metadata filter applied to memory search results. Supports nested "and" / "or" conditions and comparison operators such as "gt" for fields like "id", "created_at", or other indexed metadata. Example: {"and": [{"id": "uuid-xxx"}, {"created_at": {"gt": "2024-01-01"}}]}

internet_search.title: Internet Search
internet_search.description: Whether to enable internet search in addition to memory search. Primarily used by internal algorithms. Default: False.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Internal similarity threshold for searching plaintext memories. If None, default thresholds will be applied.

search_memory_type.title: Search Memory Type
search_memory_type.description: Memory category to search. Supported values include All, WorkingMemory, LongTermMemory, UserMemory, OuterMemory, ToolSchemaMemory, ToolTrajectoryMemory, RawFileMemory, AllSummaryMemory, SkillMemory, PreferenceMemory, DreamDiary, and InsightMemory. Default: All.

reference_time.title: Reference Time
reference_time.description: Optional reference time for time-sensitive search parsing. If omitted, search uses the current server time.

chat_history.title: Chat History
chat_history.description: Historical chat messages used internally by algorithms. If None, internal stored history may be used; if provided (even an empty list), this value will be used as-is.
